Lemon or Orange T wists Twists are 1- to 2-inch-long oval or rectangular slivers of lemon or other citrus rind that are twisted over a cocktail, releasing their essential oils into the drink. To make them, start by cutting off the “polar” nubs at each end of the fruit. Then place the fruit on one flat end and use a paring knife to gently cut off a slice of the rind, starting at the top and working your way downward. Try not to get too much of the bitter white pith. Alternatively, you can use a vegetable peeler. Hold the fruit firmly in the palm of your hand. Starting at one end and cutting straight toward the other end, carefully and steadily remove a slice of the rind.
